newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine estate firms eye 1.527 bln peso tower.
newsitem.headline: Philippine estate firms eye 1.527 bln peso tower.

text.p: Three Philippine real estate companies are planning to build a 1.527 billion peso mixed-use twin tower complex in Manila's Ortigas business district, one of the builders said on Tuesday.

DMCI Holdings Inc said its unit DMCI Project Developers Inc had signed a memorandum of agreement with Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp (Philrealty) and Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc to build a condominium on a 5,090 square metre lot owned by Philrealty.

Philrealty would own 50 percent of the joint venture, while the remaining stakes would be divided equally between the two other partners, DMCI chief financial officer Herbert Consunji told the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Initially, Philrealty would contribute the land, while the two would invest 95.437 million pesos each for the project.
